subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：Phthalimide（phthalimide (N,N-phthaloyl)）？
A. N₂H₄·H₂O, EtOH, heat
B. Pd(PPh₃)₄, PhSiH₃
C. HgCl₂, CaCO₃, MeCN/H₂O
D. Zn, AcOH
explanation: Protects a primary amine on both N–H bonds; hydrazine removes it (Ing–Manske). Hydrazine attacks both carbonyls and releases the amine and phthalhydrazide.
